verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party reporting or analytics feature showing call volume, answer rate, or missed calls broken down by number and by teammate. What it does show is raw call history via the API and MCP, plus missed-call lookups in chat. Those are building blocks a developer could use to compute such metrics, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate
